content: स्वस्तिकः [स्वस्ति शुभाय हितं क] .²1 A kind of mystical mark (卐) on persons or things denoting good luck. .²2 A lucky object. .²3 The meeting of four roads. .²4 The crossing of the arms, making a sign like the cross; स्तनविनिहितहस्तस्वस्तिकाभिर्वधूभिः <ls>Māl. 4. 10</ls>; <ls>Śi. 10. 43</ls>. .²5 A palace of particular form. .²6 A particular symbol made with ground rice and shaped like a triangle. .²7 A kind of cake. .²8 A voluptuary, libertine. .²9 Garlic. .²10 A kind of bard (who utters words of eulogy); पुरःसरैः स्वस्तिकसूतमागधैः <ls>Rām. 2. 16. 46</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> स्वस्तिका जयजयेति वादिनो वन्दिनः). .{@-कः, -कम्@} .²1 A mansion or temple of a particular form with a terrace in front. .²2 A particular mode of sitting practised by {%Yogins%} (in which the toes are placed in the inner hollow of the knees). .²3 A seat (पीठ) prepared for a deity; <ls>Mb. 12. 40. 7</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> स्वस्तिकान् सर्वतोभद्राद्यङ्कितानि देवतापीठानि).
